title: EPANET's example water distribution networks Net1, Net2 and Net3, as input files
provider: Open Water Analytics, the EPANET repository (github.com/OpenWaterAnalytics/EPANET, branch dev, example-networks/)
credit: EPANET example networks (US EPA; OpenWaterAnalytics/EPANET, MIT)
licence: EPANET is a work of the US Environmental Protection Agency in the public domain; the repository that keeps it is under the MIT licence (its LICENSE file, checked 2026-11-13).
citation: Rossman, L. A. et al. (2020), EPANET 2.2 User Manual, EPA/600/R-20/133; example networks from https://github.com/OpenWaterAnalytics/EPANET/tree/dev/example-networks
format: EPANET input files (.inp), plain text in sections ([JUNCTIONS], [PIPES], [PUMPS], [PATTERNS], [OPTIONS], ...): Net1 (9 junctions, a reservoir, a tank, 12 pipes, a pump; US units, Hazen–Williams), Net2 (36 junctions fed by a tank), Net3 (92 junctions, two reservoirs, three tanks, two pumps).
coverage: Hypothetical and generalised networks, made to teach and test hydraulic and quality models; none is a city's.
